jobs.description:
Your missionAs a Project Manager PV/BESS you will support the delivery of utility-scale Solar PV and BESS projects across Germany. The role will focus on owner-side project execution and EPC oversight from pre-NTP through construction, commissioning, COD, and handover to operations.

You will coordinate EPC contractors, technical advisors, site management, HSE consultants, grid stakeholders, and internal delivery teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the expected technical and quality standards.

Projects will typically range from 20 MW to 100 MW and include PV+BESS hybrid systems with predominantly MV but also HV grid connection scope.

The role is remote/home-office based within Germany with regular travel to project sites as required.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Coordination
• Manage utility-scale PV and PV+BESS projects during pre-construction, construction, commissioning, COD, and operational handover phases.
• Coordinate owner-side project execution activities across internal and external stakeholders.
• Ensure project delivery in accordance with schedule, budget, quality, HSE, contractual, and lender expectations.
• Support transition from development to execution phase, including pre-NTP readiness activities.

EPC & Contractor Management
• Act as primary owner-side interface toward EPC contractors and key project consultants.
• Monitor contractor performance, schedule adherence, construction progress, and execution quality.
• Track contractual obligations, risks, variations, and claims in coordination with internal legal and management teams.

Technical & Advisor Coordination
• Coordinate external technical advisors, owner’s engineers, HSE consultants, commissioning specialists, and other technical stakeholders.
• Coordinate commissioning, performance testing, punch-list management, and COD activities.
• Support grid connection coordination together with external specialists and EPC contractors.

Construction & Site Coordination
• Coordinate site managers, HSE consultants, commissioning teams, and O&M stakeholders during execution.
• Conduct regular site visits during active construction and critical project phases.
• Monitor construction progress, interface management, quality issues, and project risks.

Commercial & Reporting Responsibilities
• Maintain project schedules, risk registers, action trackers, and reporting structures.
• Support budget monitoring and change-order tracking.
• Prepare project updates and reporting for senior management and internal stakeholders.

Operational Handover
• Coordinate project close-out, warranty management, defect resolution, and handover to asset management teams and investors.
• Support establishment of stable operational interfaces with O&M providers and operational stakeholders.

Your profileProfessional Experience
• Minimum 8 years of professional experience in utility-scale solar PV project delivery, thereof at least 3 years as main responsible project manager.
• Proven experience delivering at least 5 utility-scale PV projects to COD in Germany.
• Experience with PV+BESS hybrid projects is mandatory.
• Experience working on owner-side, EPC-side, or integrated developer/EPC delivery models.
• Exposure to EPCm, multi-contracting, or free-issue equipment models considered advantageous.
• Experience with MV grid connection projects required; HV/substation experience considered a plus.

Technical & Commercial Competencies
• Strong understanding of utility-scale PV construction and commissioning processes.
• Good understanding of project delivery interfaces including EPC contractors, technical advisors, grid operators, HSE, commissioning, and O&M stakeholders.
• Basic understanding of SCADA/PPC systems, EMS/BESS integration, protection systems and commissioning and performance testing.
• Familiarity with German grid connection processes, DSO coordination, and grid-code related execution topics considered advantageous.
• Experience with project schedule management, risk management, contractor coordination, and construction reporting.
• Familiarity with German permitting and environmental compliance processes.

Education & Background
• Degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, renewable energy, construction management, project management, or related technical fields.

Language Requirements
• Fluent German and English required.
• German does not need to be native level but must be sufficient for interaction with contractors, authorities, DSOs, landowners, and project stakeholders.

Personal Profile
• Strong ownership mentality and proactive working style.
• Structured and solution-oriented approach to project execution.
• Comfortable operating in lean and fast-scaling organisations.
• Strong communication and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
• Able to work effectively under pressure and respond flexibly to changing project requirements.
• Cooperative but capable of assertive contractor management where required.
• High professional standards and strong commitment to project success and delivery quality.

Why us?
• Flexible working hours, work-from-home
• Exciting and responsible tasks with plenty of room for your own ideas
• Motivated team and flat hierarchies
• Internal and external training opportunities
• Permanent employment contract

jobs.description:
The Faculty of Process and Systems Engineering, Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering seeks to fill the following vacancy:

Junior Group Leader (m/f/d) in Computational Multiphase Flow

Salary scale:
13 TV-L

Date commencing:
As soon as possible

Fixed term:
3 years*

Contract status:
100 %

At the Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering (www.mvt.ovgu.de), we are a group of enthusiastic researchers with extensive research activities in the numerical modelling of multiphase flows. Our work addresses the fundamental physical mechanisms governing dispersed and interfacial multiphase flows, as well as their application to engineering systems. Current research topics include particle-laden and droplet-laden turbulent flows, particle–turbulence and droplet–turbulence interactions, the dynamics of non-spherical particles, interfacial flows, and compressible and incompressible multiphase-flow applications. Approximately eight PhD researchers and three postdoctoral researchers currently work in this area at the Chair.

The objective of the advertised position is to attract a junior group leader who will take a leading role in our computational multiphase-flow research. The successful candidate will contribute to and help coordinate ongoing research projects, while also establishing their own research direction within the Chair. The position offers excellent opportunities to develop an independent academic profile and to pursue a Habilitation. It therefore combines scientific leadership in existing activities with the opportunity to initiate new research topics and contribute to the further development of our numerical methods and simulation tools.

Our in-house simulation framework includes state-of-the-art methods for immersed boundaries, Lagrangian particle and droplet tracking, non-spherical particle dynamics, particle and droplet interactions, gas–liquid interfaces, large-eddy simulation, and fully coupled solvers for compressible and incompressible flows. You will also have the opportunity to establish your own teaching portfolio in areas such as numerical methods, multiphase flows, or particle technology.

*The position is full time for a period of 3 years with the opportunity to extend by a further 3 years.

Job description:

- Develop, implement, and analyse analytical and numerical models for multiphase flows
- Establish an independent research profile in computational multiphase-flow modelling
- Lead and coordinate the further development of our in-house simulation tools in C and MPI
- Develop research ideas and prepare proposals for externally funded research projects
- Supervise PhD researchers, postdoctoral researchers, and students working in computational multiphase flows
- Contribute to teaching in multiphase flows, numerical methods, particle technology, or related subjects
- Contribute to the scientific development and coordination of the computational multiphase-flow group
- Opportunity for further scientific qualification, including the possibility to pursue a Habilitation

Requirements profile:

- A Master’s degree or equivalent and a PhD in mechanical engineering, process engineering, aerospace engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or a related discipline
- A strong background in the physical and numerical modelling of fluid-mechanical or multiphase-flow problems
- Demonstrated research experience in computational multiphase flows, such as particle-laden, droplet-laden, or interfacial flows
- Strong scientific-programming skills in C, C++, or Fortran, including experience with MPI and high-performance computing
- Experience in developing numerical methods or simulation software; expertise in techniques such as immersed-boundary methods, Lagrangian tracking, interface-capturing methods, or particle-interaction models is desirable
- A strong publication record commensurate with your career stage, together with the ability to develop independent research ideas and contribute to research proposals
- Excellent written and spoken English, as well as a good command of German or a commitment to acquiring sufficient German proficiency for teaching and administrative duties within two years

For further information about the position, please contact Prof. Berend van Wachem by email, berend.vanwachem(at)ovgu.de

You will benefit from our structures and offerings in the fields of sustainability, diversity, family support and staff development. Our location in the center of a thriving, lively and family-friendly state capital guarantees a high quality of life and a wide range of leisure activities. For more information, please visit www.ovgu.de/en/karriere (http://www.ovgu.de/en/karriere) .

A Snapshot of Your Day 

Do you want to shape how a global manufacturing network thinks about data, AI, and the cloud? Also, you will lead the implementation of AI-driven workflows, e.g. integrating Azure OpenAI, building ML pipelines, and modernizing legacy systems, while also guiding executive leadership on strategic priorities. Every day, you'll balance ambitious architectural thinking with the satisfaction of shipping real, scalable solutions that move the organization toward a truly cloud-native future.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Designing scalable, secure Azure and Snowflake architectures by translating complex requirements from the global manufacturing network into future-proof cloud solutions
* Leading hands-on implementation of cloud and ML solutions by integrating Azure OpenAI into live data workflows and deploying robust CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps
* Driving modernization of legacy systems and automate data flows across production, sales, and finance domains to support a leaner, cloud-native organization
* Acting as a senior thought leader and sparring partner for Azure-based applications, owning the documentation and scaling of architectural designs across the organization
* Communicate architectural strategies and project outcomes clearly to both executive leadership and technical teams, bridging vision and delivery with confidence

What You Bring

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Cloud Engineering, or a related field, paired with many years of experience in cloud architecture
* Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Azure and Snowflake including AI/ML integration, Python, SQL, and API development with a proven track record of delivering production-grade solutions
* Strong strategic planning and influencing skills: you're as comfortable shaping a multi-year architecture roadmap as you are aligning stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), generative AI services, and cloud-based modernization of enterprise systems
* You are business fluent in English; fluency in German is a strong plus

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder

Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. - Ability to work in a team and willingness to learn

- Very good German skills and good English skills

Good reasons for Global Metal Forming Group

- You can expect an interesting and responsible job within an internationally successful medium-sized company

- Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair any issues that occur.
- Being a major part in building and help growing our new team in Dresden.

Skills and Experience that we are looking for:

- Bachelors / master’s degree / Level 6 or equivalent qualification in Mechanical, Electronical or Mechatronic Engineering or Certified Technician.
- Willingness to work on complex electro-mechanical equipment in a cleanroom manufacturing environment.
- Good manual dexterity with a high focus on safety and quality.
- Aptitude to work with electro-mechanical schematics and ladder logic.
- Good communication skills with the ability to work independently as well as the team environment.
- Working knowledge of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).
- Fluent in English and German language and a valid work permit for an EU country is essential.
- Willing to travel to other EU customers and support our company affiliates in the US and Asia.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (f/m/d) located in Eindhoven & Dortmund (Software-Architect)
jobs.description:
Your mission Join Innolume

At Innolume, we develop innovative optoelectronic semiconductor technologies that power next-generation communication and sensing applications worldwide.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Software Engineer (f/m/d) who will work across our locations in Eindhoven and Dortmund and is comfortable traveling regularly between both sites.

In this role, you will modernize our software landscape, develop scalable applications, and connect software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment. Your work will directly support the development and production of cutting-edge photonic semiconductor devices while helping shape the next generation of our digital engineering environment.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and want to see your software making a tangible impact in a high-tech manufacturing environment, we would love to meet you.

Build the Software behind tomorrow's Semiconductor Technology:
• Design, develop and maintain software for automated measurement, equipment control and data acquisition
• Build scalable desktop applications and software architectures for engineering and manufacturing
• Modernise legacy software applications and migrate existing LabVIEW solutions to sustainable software platforms
• Integrate laboratory instruments, manufacturing equipment, databases, MES and ERP systems
• Develop reliable software interfaces and efficient data pipelines
• Improve software quality, maintainability and performance using modern engineering principles
• Troubleshoot complex software-hardware interactions in close collaboration with engineering teams
• Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Quality and IT to deliver reliable software solutions
• Contribute to the digital transformation of semiconductor manufacturing

Your profile
• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering or a related technical field
• Several years of professional software development experience
• Strong programming skills in Python and/or C# (C++ is an advantage)
• Solid understanding of software architecture, object-orientated programming and modern software engineering principles
• Experience developing desktop applications
• Experience with SQL databases and data management
• Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent English language skills (spoken and written)

Nice to have
• German language skills are an advantage
• Experience with laboratory automation or industrial software
• Experience integrating laboratory instruments or manufacturing equipment
• Knowledge of MES, ERP or industrial communication interfaces
• Experience migrating legacy software systems
• Familiarity with Industry 4.0, process monitoring, or machine learning
• Experience in the semiconductor industry

Why us?What we offer:
• Exciting software projects in a highly innovative semiconductor environment
• The opportunity to shape a modern software platform with long-term impact
• An international, interdisciplinary team with flat hierarchies
• Short decision-making paths and a collaborative working culture
• Professional development and continuous learning opportunities
• Flexible working hours and an attractive compensation package

Join Innolume and help us develop the software that powers the next generation of photonic semiconductor technologies.
Career starters, graduates, and candidates with initial professional experience are encouraged to apply.?
We look forward to receiving your application.
Please send your complete application documents to jolanta.rzesa@innolume.com

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Computational Chemistry (f/m/d) (Pay scale 13 TV-L, 67 %) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description:
We are a young, innovative university in the middle of the Metropole Ruhr. Excellent in research and teaching, we think in terms of possibilities instead of limits and develop ideas with a future. We live diversity, promote potential and are committed to educational equity.
The University of Duisburg-Essen invites applications for the position of a
PhD Student in Computational Chemistry (f/m/d) (Pay scale 13 TV-L, 67 %) (gross 38.265 – 54.388 €)
at the Faculty of Chemistry, Institute for Physical Chemistry (located at the campus in Essen).
The Faculty of Chemistry at the UDE is one of the largest chemistry faculties in Germany and offers three study programs under one roof: Chemistry, Water Science and Chemistry Teachers College. The young and dynamic research group led by Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt focuses on elucidating the structures and reactions of transition-metal enzymes with computer simulations, thereby bridging the fields of computational chemistry and quantum crystallography.

Your tasks

You will conduct research within the project “Boosting Enzymatic Plastic Recycling via Future Computing” as part of the NRW Return Programme of Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt. The main focus of your position will be on evaluating quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) calculations on metalloenzymes and exploring whether machine learning can be used for predictions of enzymatic reactions in biomass and plastic degradation. In these areas, you will closely collaborate with postdoctoral and PhD researchers who have experience in QM/MM calculations of metalloenzymes and machine learning. Additionally, you will contribute to supervising students, teaching activities, and administrative tasks, aligned with your transferable skill development.

Your profile

- By the time of appointment, you will have successfully completed your university studies in chemistry, biochemistry, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, biology, physics or a related field with a standard period of study of at least eight semesters (minimum 270 credit points or equivalent) and an average grade of at least ‘good’ (or equivalent)
- You are highly motivated to pursue research in sustainable chemistry and push the boundaries of computational biochemistry
- Ideally, you have first experience in QM calculations and their analysis. Experience with QM/MM or QM-cluster calculations on enzymes is desirable but not required; you are eager to learn these methods
- Previous experience in the use of machine learning and/or QM software packages, high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, and Linux operating systems will be considered an advantage
- You demonstrate scientific curiosity, take responsibility for your own work, and actively contribute to team-oriented, interdisciplinary, and international collaborations inside and outside the research group. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential
The position offers the opportunity for further scientific qualification.

We offer

- An interesting and responsible research position with broad opportunities for academic and personal growth, allowing you to take responsibility and establish valuable connections with academic and industrial collaborators locally as well as internationally
- A supportive and appreciative working atmosphere within a highly motivated, international and diverse research group. We look forward to welcoming and onboarding our new team member
- Fully funded participation in national and international workshops, summer schools, and conferences as well as dedicated presentation training
- Training in state-of-the-art computational methods and software (e.g., ORCA, AMBER) as well as access to significant HPC resources (e.g., the cluster AmplitUDE (https://escience-wissr.gitpages.uni-due.de/hpc-support/content/amplitUDE/amplitude_hardware.html) )
- Access to graduate courses, transferable skills training and the possibility to apply for the Water Graduate School (WGS (https://www.uni-due.de/zwu/wgs.php) )
- Family-friendly policies, including childcare support
- Advisory services for employees with family care responsibilities
- Possibility to enrol as a student, granting access to student housing, local public transport throughout Germany (Deutschlandsemesterticket (https://www.uni-due.de/faq-studium/semesterticket_en.php) ) and discounts at university canteens, museums, etc.
- Excellent public transport connections and free parking
- Access to attractive sports and health programs (university sports)
- The possibility of remote work
Starting date: 01.12.2026
Contract period: 36 months (3 years) with the possibility of extension
Working time: 67% of a full-time employment (part-time employment is possible)
Application deadline: 25.09.2026
Please submit your application (motivation letter, CV, diplomas, transcript of records with grades, at least two references) quoting reference 416-26 to: Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt, Universität Duisburg-Essen, Fakultät für Chemie, Campus Essen, 45117 Essen. Please compile your application in a single PDF file and send it via email to applications.wieduwilt@uni-due.de.
Additional information about our research and group can be found at:
- About the project “Boosting Enzymatic Plastic Recycling via Future Computing”: https://www.uni-due.de/2025-12-08-professor-erna-wieduwilt-researches-plastic-recycling
- About the group: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/erna-wieduwilt_scienceisteamwork-chemistry-mint-activity-7482096217875857408-1d_R?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desk-top&rcm=ACoAADDOYrUBY5t0a3GvPalmhq6zjRkeWRjRhdk (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/erna-wieduwilt_scienceisteamwork-chemistry-mint-activity-7482096217875857408-1d_R?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desk-top&rcm=ACoAADDOYrUBY5t0a3GvPalmhq6zjRkeWRjRhdk)
- Current webpage: https://www.uni-due.de/zmb/members/erna-wieduwilt.php
The University of Duisburg-Essen is committed to promoting diversity among its members (see https://www.uni-due.de/diversity/en/). It aims to increase the number of women in academic positions and therefore explicitly encourages qualified women to apply. Women will be given preference in accordance with the North Rhine-Westphalia State Equality Act (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW) if they have equivalent qualifications. Applications from suitable severely disabled persons and persons of equal status within the meaning of Section 2 (3) SGB IX are welcome.
